tokenizer.name: t5-small
tokenizer.forced_eos_rule: If EOS is absent after left truncation, replace the last retained token with EOS exactly as CollatorGRAM.encode_texts_split.

population.unit: Every catalog item present in item_plain_text, item index, and similar-item file for each locked dataset.
population.popularity: Training-only occurrence count from sequence[:-2] for every user; validation sequence[-2] and test sequence[-1] are excluded.
population.strata: Dataset-specific zero, nonzero-bottom-50%, and top-50% popularity groups; descriptive only.

paired_serializations.metadata_first: item: <link>; <metadata>; similar items: <same fixed CF identities>
invariants: Same ordered CF identities and CF lexical strings
Only the order of collaborative field and metadata field changes

field_accounting.method: Fast-tokenizer offset mappings over the full serialized passage, followed by the exact delimiter filter, left truncation, forced-EOS and padding rules.
field_accounting.raw_definition: Non-padding, non-EOS field-overlapping tokens after the Collator's 999-token tokenizer ceiling and delimiter filter but before the 128-token left truncation.
field_accounting.visible_definition: Non-padding, non-EOS field-overlapping tokens after the exact 128-token Collator rule.
field_accounting.lost_definition: raw minus visible for the same serialization and field.
field_accounting.recoverable_metadata_tokens: visible metadata tokens in metadata_first minus visible metadata tokens in current.
field_accounting.displaced_cf_tokens: visible collaborative tokens in current minus visible collaborative tokens in metadata_first.

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any integrity, lineage, parsing, component-identity, exact-replay, or finite-value gate fails.
decision_rule.stop_no_structural_displacement: Either dataset fails any preregistered mechanism gate.
decision_rule.g0_d2_design_allowed: All integrity and mechanism gates pass on both datasets.

interpretation_limits: Passing proves structural displacement and diagnostic room only; it does not prove lost metadata is useful.
The metadata-first construction is a paired census instrument, not the proposed final method.
No model checkpoint, prediction score, target, validation effect, test field, training, or GPU is used.
Popularity strata and individual metadata fields are descriptive and cannot rescue a failed primary gate.
expected_outputs: report/第三阶段/GRAM_第三阶段_CPBD_G0_D1诊断报告.md
